title: Borrow the Tags
goal: Keep using tags after the call - 0 clones, and take the most flexible parameter type.
hints: The move happens because Vec<String> takes ownership. What does join_tags actually need?
&Vec<String> compiles, but Clippy will tell you why a slice is the better borrow.
explanation: join_tags only reads the strings, so it should borrow. Cloning the Vec (and every String inside it!) buys nothing. Between the two borrows, `&[String]` wins over `&Vec<String>`: a &Vec argument coerces to a slice automatically, and the slice version also accepts arrays and sub-slices - Clippy's ptr_arg lint exists precisely for this.
